worldcombat.skill.hornattack.summary: The user lowers its head, drives the horn in and keeps it locked in the wound while its whole body shoves the target backward across the ground: not a single knockback but a stretch of sustained pushing. It is the family's only move that locks on and bulldozes, and the heavier the user the farther it drives.
worldcombat.skill.hornattack.use.0: Gore a close target and shove it off
worldcombat.skill.hornattack.use.1: Drive a foe across the ground away from cover or position
worldcombat.skill.hornattack.description: The horn point deals about %1$s contact damage; reach about %2$s blocks with a %3$s block horn half-width.

The hit shoves the target about %1$s blocks at once; the horn stays locked, the user follows and keeps pushing it along the ground to a total of about %2$s blocks including that first shove, and a wall or a target that will not budge ends the push.
worldcombat.skill.hornattack.drive.on: Bulldoze form: carries the target about %1$s blocks and about %2$s damage per gore, but with a longer wind-up, recovery and cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.hornattack.drive.off: Quick form: releases after about %1$s blocks and about %2$s damage, with the shortest wind-up and cycle.
worldcombat.skill.hornattack.timing: Reach %1$s blocks; %2$s seconds of wind-up, %3$s seconds of recovery, %4$s PP, then a %5$s second cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.hornattack.growth.0: At level %1$s each gore rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.hornattack.growth.1: At level %1$s each gore rises to %2$s and the carry to %3$s blocks.
On (bulldoze): carry x1.6 and gore damage x1.08, at the cost of +3 ticks of wind-up, +2 of recovery and +5 of cooldown. Off (quick): releases after a short push, with a faster wind-up and a shorter cycle.
worldcombat.skill.hornattack.description: One cast gores at most a single foe on the horn line and never hits allies, leaving other targets alone; before the stab the user lurches up to about %1$s blocks toward the target, stopping once the horn tip is in contact (less if blocked). The locked push that follows deals no further damage.
